description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and classes related to sparse tensor operations in the ATen library, including functions for manipulating sparse tensor indices, converting formats, and managing tensor geometry.

classes.name: TensorGeometryHolder
classes.description: A template class for managing tensor shape and stride information, with specializations for fixed-size and dynamic-size tensors.

methods.name: get_sparse_impl
methods.description: Retrieves the internal SparseTensorImpl pointer from a sparse tensor.

methods.name: alias_into_sparse
methods.description: Directly sets the indices and values of a sparse tensor without copying.

methods.name: copy_into_sparse
methods.description: Copies indices and values into a sparse tensor, with optional non-blocking behavior.

methods.name: is_same_tensor
methods.description: Checks if two tensors share the same underlying implementation.

methods.name: is_same_density
methods.description: Checks if two sparse tensors have the same sparse and dense dimensions.

methods.name: new_values_with_size_of
methods.description: Creates a new tensor with the same shape as 'values' but with a specified number of non-zero elements.

methods.name: flatten_indices
methods.description: Flattens a sparse indices tensor into a 1D tensor.

methods.name: flatten_indices_by_dims
methods.description: Partially flattens sparse tensor indices over specified dimensions.

methods.name: coo_to_csr
methods.description: Converts COO format indices to CSR format.

methods.name: zeros_like_with_indices
methods.description: Creates a tensor similar to 't' but filled with zeros, preserving indices.

methods.name: full_coo_indices
methods.description: Generates all indices for a tensor of a given shape efficiently.
